content.text:
All three PNGs are rendered at the exact pixel sizes and verified defect-free (no overflow, no clipping, no overlap; portrait is a perfect circle at every size; the long talk title wraps fully).

**Files in the working folder**
- `square.png` — 1080×1080 master: logo + event name, portrait circle with name/role beside it, 4-line title, date/venue left and pill CTA right.
- `landscape.png` — 1920×1080: two-column layout, text column left (brand, 3-line title, date + CTA together so the button isn't stranded mid-canvas), 308px portrait circle with name/role on the right.
- `story.png` — 1080×1920: centered stack with a 384px portrait, evenly distributed vertical rhythm (`align-content: space-between`), CTA above the date line.
- `card.html` — the source, with Inter loaded via `@font-face` and one `?size=` switch driving all three layouts.

Design details: `#0F1226` background with subtle violet radial glows, violet `#7C5CFF` accent on the role line, the avatar ring, the word "trust" in the title, and the pill button.
